title: The letter
steps: You stand at the end of a long path before a great iron gate, as the sun begins to set. But how did you get here? To answer that, we must go back a few weeks, to the day a very special letter arrived.

It was an invitation to your first year at Arvelia, a school of magic! It was signed by Orla, the head of the school. Tucked inside was a picture of an old castle on a hill, high above a deep, quiet lake. Your heart must have skipped a beat as you read it.
Then came the journey. You packed your bags, traveled the long road to the village at the foot of the hill, and climbed the steep path in the fading light. And now, here you are.

The gate stands tall and firmly shut. It has no handle to turn and no bell to ring. You do not have a wand yet, and you know no magic at all. Still, the old iron gate is very quiet, almost as if it were listening for something.
Before your story goes any further, there is one very important question to answer. Who are you?
